8cf4e8fe23fb.summary: You’ll design how our agents listen, interpret, respond, and guide patients through real healthcare workflows. From conversation structure and language choices to tool use, transfers, and recovery when something goes wrong, you’ll turn complex requirements into conversations that feel natural and accomplish the task.
wants: 1+ years experience in conversational design, voice user experience, or a closely related field, with hands-on experience building AI agents or conversational systems from scratch.
Experience working closely with voice AI agents, including designing, testing, and refining how they behave in real conversations.
Strong understanding of conversation structure, turn-taking, intent recognition, ambiguity, clarification, and recovery when an interaction goes off track.
Hands-on prompt engineering skills and the ability to translate customer workflows into agent instructions, conversation flows, and decision logic.
Ability to review calls and transcripts, identify patterns in conversational failures, and turn those findings into concrete improvements.
Technical fluency with agent-building platforms, tool calls, APIs, and integrations, including how system constraints affect the conversation.

4c6cc32a0e76.summary: Join us to help define how people and AI agents work together. We move with urgency, reason from first principles, and take ownership from idea to customer impact. You’ll shape the product, own consequential problems, and build systems that some of the world’s leading brands depend on every day.
does: Lead enterprise transformation engagements across two strategic customers, owning discovery, operating model design, value measurement and executive recommendations from start to finish.
Redesign how marketing organizations operate by identifying opportunities for AI agents to take on work, eliminate manual handoffs and fundamentally improve how teams execute.
Facilitate collaborative workshops with executives, functional leaders and practitioners to map existing processes, challenge assumptions and co-design future-state workflows.
Define new operating models that clarify how people and AI agents work together, including responsibilities, decision rights, governance and processes.
Build financial models and business cases that quantify the impact of transformation through reduced cycle times, improved productivity, automation rates and measurable cost savings.
Establish clear success metrics and baselines that connect customer transformation initiatives to tangible business outcomes and support ongoing measurement of realized value.

ecdac2953ffb.summary: This is a foundational hire. You will do different aspects of dispatching in trucking — without needing any trucking experience. You’ll keep real freight moving for real customers: assigning loads, communicating with drivers, handling exceptions, and solving the problems of the day.
does: Run daily dispatch execution from our playbook: load assignment, driver communication, check-calls, and exception handling
Keep loads covered and customers informed, escalating with judgment when something can’t wait
Use AI tools daily to research, troubleshoot, draft, analyze, and automate your own work
Improve the playbook as you go — document what works, flag what doesn’t, and ship a better process every week
Call out problems early and come with proposed solutions, not just escalations
Partner with engineering and product to turn recurring manual work into automated workflows
wants: A recent degree or 1–2 years of work experience — high-performing new grads encouraged to apply
AI-native habits: you already use AI as your default tool for learning, research, and producing work
Sharp critical thinking — you spot what’s broken, ask why, and bring a proposed answer
Hungry and coachable: you want direction, feedback, and a steep learning curve
Strong written and verbal communication — you’ll be talking to drivers, customers, and engineers in the same hour
Organized and calm under pressure; comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

3cc4eb9d742a.summary: We're looking for people who want to take ownership, solve hard problems, and build technology that delivers real business impact.
does: Own our Oracle integration strategy: Define integration patterns, reference architectures, and technical standards across Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement and Oracle E-Business Suite.
Build enterprise-grade integrations: Design and implement data flows using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, BI Publisher, OTBI, and cXML.

Work directly with enterprise customers: Lead technical workshops with procurement teams, IT stakeholders, and implementation partners to translate complex business requirements into scalable solutions.
Get hands-on: Configure integrations, troubleshoot interface errors, resolve data inconsistencies, and support deployments from testing through go-live.
Connect AI with enterprise procurement: Enable our agents to interact with requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, supplier data, catalogs, and invoices.
Shape our product: Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to turn customer-specific integration challenges into reusable product capabilities.
wants: 5+ years of hands-on Oracle experience, with deep expertise in enterprise procurement.
Strong experience implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud Procurement and/or Oracle E-Business Suite, ideally across multiple enterprise projects.
Solid understanding of procurement processes, including Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Source-to-Contract (S2C), purchasing, and invoice processing.
Experience integrating Oracle Procurement with Financials, Supply Chain, and external applications.
Technical proficiency with OIC, Oracle APIs, FBDI, SQL, data mappings, and integration troubleshooting.
Experience owning technical workstreams or solution architecture in complex enterprise environments.
